workOrders.summary: Technician logged the RF match network on chamber A hunting between tune positions. A worn load capacitor was suspected and a replacement was ordered but not fitted. The source power oscillation on the oscilloscope matches that fault.
Foreline pump bearing hours are past the service interval on D-02. Vibration has been rising. The bearing was not replaced.
An operator edited the RF power recipe setpoint on E-03 in the MES recipe. There is no engineering change order for that edit.
